PRODUCT.description: A named product in the Meridian suite.
do_not_mark: generic references like "the app" or "the platform"
a trailing noun after the name, like "dashboard" in "the Meridian Cloud dashboard"

examples.text: Complete outage on Meridian API v2.9.14 for our Paris office. Everything returns HTTP 429.

FEATURE.description: A named capability inside a product.
do_not_mark: verbs describing an action, like "exporting" or "logging in"
determiners: annotate "billing portal", not "the billing portal"

examples.text: Can we get a refund for the duplicate $49 charge on May 22? It appears twice in the audit log.
Does Meridian API support exporting scheduled reports data to Zapier on a schedule?

ERROR_CODE.description: An error identifier, including HTTP statuses.
do_not_mark: the word "error" in front of the code

examples.text: Webhooks rejects our Okta credentials with E2210 since April 17.

VERSION.description: A release identifier of the vendor's own software.
do_not_mark: version numbers of the customer's operating system or browser

examples.text: CSV export in Meridian Cloud v3.4.0 started failing with SYNC-409 after we upgraded on March 3.

INTEGRATION.description: A third-party service the product connects to. Decided by its role in the sentence, not by the company: "syncing to Spotify" is an integration, "our team at Spotify" is not.
do_not_mark: a company named as the customer, like "our team at Spotify"

examples.text: Is there a way to connect Meridian Mobile to Slack so records sync automatically?
